reason: A session-memory plugin that incrementally indexes conversation and tool activity, stores a local derived index, and exposes cross-session search and index statistics.

summaries.zh: 索引会话消息、助手回复和工具活动，并通过本地持久化索引提供跨会话搜索与统计工具。
summaries.en: Indexes session messages, assistant replies, and tool activity, then provides cross-session search and index statistics through a locally persisted index.

capabilities: indexes user messages, assistant replies, tool calls, tool results, and session titles
persists derived index documents as JSONL files
combines in-memory search with SQLite FTS5 when enabled
renders grouped search-result cards in the web UI
removes its derived index data when a session is disposed
